findings.passage: The safety of our communities is of the utmost importance, and one crucial way to keep them safe is to tackle gun violence,
findings.note: Quoted in a House caucus release as co-chair of the PA Safe Caucus, welcoming four gun bills voted out of committee: report lost or stolen guns (HB 338), background checks on every sale (HB 714), safe storage (HB 731), and a court process to temporarily disarm someone in crisis (HB 1018). He called the committee votes a great step in the right direction.

findings.passage: With the current gun violence crisis taking place in Philadelphia and around the commonwealth, today’s passage of two bills out of the House is a step in the right direction to prevent future tragedies,
findings.note: Quoted in a House caucus release after the House passed HB 1018 (extreme risk protection orders) and HB 714 (universal background checks). He added: "As co-chair of the PA Safe Caucus, I applaud my colleagues who voted to make the commonwealth a safer place."
